rev.t: Great experience at this store everytime I come. I am always well serviced and helped with any questions I have. I really like how they cut any fruit you like for free and right in front of you!! Rubhan and Krishnendu are my favorite staff very helpful and respectful!! They deserve a raise!!

Great store with a wide range of products. They have an excellent selection of chocolates, including many that are hard to find elsewhere. The store also offers a variety of alcoholic beverages, making it a convenient spot for all your shopping needs.
